name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 109/1
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘as a result of rule of law breaches’
part_context: Stresses that a robust approach is needed to ensure that legitimate final recipients and beneficiaries are not penalised because EU funds for their government have been suspended <del>as a result of rule of law breaches</del>; stresses that this principle lies at the core of a smarter conditionality approach;
